geometry_basis.threshold: source PNG alpha >= 64 and max RGB >= 64
updated_bounds: all three M2 sequence bounds at sequence +32

shadow_prison.timing: conditional Shadow Prison state; may be hidden or absent on Warmane
shadow_prison.anchor: state kit on the aura holder if the client renders the area-aura state

empowered_vortex.timing: direct player-origin burst/cast cue; not advance warning
empowered_vortex.anchor: cloned CastKit on each player force-casting the burst

blood_nova.timing: selected-target parent impact cue; not advance warning
blood_nova.anchor: cloned parent ImpactKit on the selected target; damage/dummy chain untouched

limitations: Static model units are intended as yards but require in-game calibration.
The direct Vortex and Blood Nova cues are resolution-time diagnostics, not advance spacing warnings.
Shadow Prison is encounter-wide heroic behavior and may be hidden or unrendered on Warmane.
Blood Nova target-side attachment is inferred from the selected-target parent ImpactKit and must be observed in game.
Circle overlap alone does not mean player centres are within 12 yards.
